reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {email} is no longer valid. Enter the new one.

api_unreachable.title: DietoPro is not responding
api_unreachable.description: Nutriplan Bridge could not fetch data from DietoPro in the last {failures} updates in a row. Check your connection or whether DietoPro is down; it will recover on its own once it answers again.

plan_format.title: The plan has an unexpected format
plan_format.description: DietoPro returned the plan without the list of days this integration expects. Their API may have changed. Download the diagnostics (Settings → Devices & services → Nutriplan Bridge) and share them on the integration's repository.
